notes: §5.3.13: "Uses are never folded. If a use matches no visible declaration exactly but has the same skeleton as exactly one, the error is K0401 (\"`اكتب` is not defined\"), with a machine fix to the declared spelling." D19: `کتاب` (Persian kaf U+06A9) folds to the skeleton of `كتاب`, and uses are never folded.
